about_the_game:
In the gripping adventure game About Last Chanks, you wake up as a damaged robot in a dark, hostile cave with no memory of how you got there. Your system is unstable and a critical defect is causing your energy to dwindle inexorably. You have one last chance.

Your task is clear: find new chances, conserve your energy and survive long enough to fix the defect and discover the truth about your existence. However, remember that every movement costs energy and every decision costs time, and time is your most valuable resource.

The path leads through a mysterious world full of dangers, such as deep ravines that disappear into the darkness, dilapidated lifts, unstable platforms, and challenging puzzles that often have to be solved under extreme time pressure.

Co-op multiplayer:

As well as the solo experience, you can play together in co-op mode. Two robots are connected to each other via an energy cable. Energy is shared, so cooperation is essential. Every mistake affects both of you; every smart decision could save you. Only through perfect teamwork can you collect enough Chanks to survive.

As you delve deeper into this world, the bigger picture gradually emerges: What happened here? Why did you wake up? And what are Chanks really?

Last Chanks challenges you to think quickly, act precisely, and use your resources wisely because, when your energy runs out, it's game over.
